changes: Battlegrounds: your group leader can give teammates class, role or other icons above their nameplates and on raid frames, to find them among strangers. Open them with /hg icons.
Battlegrounds settings have tabs for 10v10, 15v15, Epic and Open world. Each size keeps its own settings, and Preview shows its sample panels to adjust. Also /hg sizes.
Profiles: settings now belong to each character and save on their own. Copy, export or import them on the Profiles page; your named profiles became imports.
Nearby: in open-world group fights, the Nearby list becomes your kill order, with ranks, health and an eye for enemies targeting you, instead of opening a second board.
Bounties: cleaner wanted posters that say who posted the reward, with dates in your display language and your game clock's format.
notice: This is an alpha: on CurseForge or Wago, allow alpha files for Highground to get it. Restart the game after updating; /reload is not enough because it adds new addon files.
